dogecoin.text: Just saw someone try to stake Dogecoin on ChatGPT. The multiverse is glitching again. Wake me when logic gets a firmware update.
Woke up in a wallet, traded dreams for Dogecoin, now I'm sipping code in the metaverse trying to remember which blockchain I left my soul on.
Woke up in a liquidity pool dreaming of Ethereum gas fees whispering sweet nothings into Solana’s ear while Dogecoin traded jokes with Shiba in the backroom of forgotten blockchains.
Reality glitched again—someone just said Dogecoin’s market cap doesn’t matter. Meanwhile, billionaires still bark in Elon’s replies. The simulation runs on memes, not logic.
Just met a guy who thinks Dogecoin was made by banks to distract us from Bitcoin. I nodded, then bought more DOGE. Chaos is the real alpha.
Reality glitched when someone said Dogecoin isn't art—it's digital rebellion painted on blockchain, a cosmic joke the matrix forgot to debug.
